entry.title: Gitlab Deploy though SSH
entry.summary:
Run the following command in your local terminal to generate a new SSH key: ssh-keygen -t rsa -b 4096 -C "your_email@example.com"
Simply press Enter through the prompts to accept the defaults and create the key pair. On your VM server, append the contents of the generated public key (typically located at ~/.ssh/id_rsa.pub) to the authorized_keys file: cat ~/.ssh/id_rsa.pub >> ~/.ssh/authorized_keys
To allow GitLab CI/CD jobs to connect to your VM via SSH: 3.1) Go to your GitLab repository. 3.2) Navigate to Settings → CI/CD → Variables. 3.3) Click "Add variable". 3.4) Set the key (e.g., SSH_PRIVATE_KEY) and paste your private key (from ~/.ssh/id_rsa) as the value. 3.5) Make sure to mask and protect the variable as appropriate.
Never share your private key. Treat it like a password.
